root_cause: buildReactionRumor stamped created_at = floor(now/1000) while stores resolve add vs removal per triple at one-second resolution with ties going to the removal. A re-add within the removal's second lost on every receiver while the sender's optimistic row was bumped past it (and the mirror: a removal within a future-stamped re-add's second lost).
fix: buildReactionRumor takes notBeforeSec. New prepareOwnReaction(thread, …, build) runs in ONE per-thread queue step (same queue/Web Lock as the store writes): reads current rows, computes the floor (re-add: removal second + 1; removal: add second), builds the rumor once, persists the optimistic row/tombstone stamped at the rumor's second. Group (ChatStoreContext) and DM (ContactChat) senders use it. An identical-id retry after a rolled-back re-add revives that pending tombstone.

tests_added.kinds: floor helper cases; build-once + stamp agreement; peer-store convergence (remove/re-add, re-add/remove, reversed delivery, 9-toggle burst); intervening queued write; failed re-add + identical-id retry; revival refusal for confirmed rows; exact createdAt/triple-match assertions

mutation.survivors: equivalent: removedAt!==undefined guards unreachable (legacy tombstones take the append path; rolled-back pending rows always carry removedAt); notBeforeSec!==undefined redundant with Number.isFinite

e2e.result: non-relay 72 passed; relay 352 passed, 19 skipped, 1 failed (AC-60 groups-dm-reactions: composer Enter press timed out after 30 s, before any reaction code ran; known undiagnosed load stall, filed as dm-composer-enter-press-hangs-30s); no INVALID marker. groups-dm-reactions rerun 5x in isolation on a fresh relay: 5/5 green (4/4 each).

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The first version read the floor outside the store's write queue; only adversarial review spotted the cross-tab interleaving, and the retry-after-rollback case surfaced only on the second adversarial pass.
retrospective.surprised_by: Stamping a rumor in the future (to beat a same-second removal) makes an identical-id retry within that second collide with the rolled-back row, so idempotency-on-id needed a narrow exception.
